items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: Pete used to help me out a whole lot... he'd show me a different thing... that's my teacher. He said, you done beat your teacher.

ctx.x: Yeah. And so every time I'd blow the horn, I'd lay it down. I'd go press a piece. I'd come back, blow the horn, go back and press another piece. And my wife says, gee whiz, you make me sick with this thing. I said, well, I might make you sick now. I said, but someday this thing will come in handy. Because I'd find out what it was all about, you see. So finally, after I kind of got good with it, Giles came along. He wanted me to join a little band that was putting up a little brass band back on that street. So I…
Well, what part of town were you born? Did you give that street?
